reviewer.name: Codex independent Hanshu 038 post-curation chronology auditor

summary: Complete fresh independent post-curation audit of all 275 Chinese units, 131 temporal/hint items, and 56 people. Curated repairs preserve source wording and remove unsupported chronology. 84 remaining source-qualified research holds prevent approval; no further source-backed defect or omitted dated personal event was found.
